units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 4</cite> (expl. <he>עצמותי</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">ib.</cite>) [read:] <he>עִיצּוּמִי בָּנַי שהיו כבני העצומים</he> (he broke) my strength, that is, my sons who were like the sons of the mighty.
<cite ref="Shabbat 86b">Sabb. 86ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 278:1">Yalk. Ex. 278</cite> (ref. to <he>זכור את וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 13:3">Ex. XIII, 3</cite>, a.

<cite ref="Exodus 20:8">XX, 8</cite>) <he>מה להלן בעִיצּוּמוֹ של יום וכ׳</he> as there the word was delivered on the selfsame day (of the exodus), so it was here on the selfsame day (on a Sabbath day).

<cite ref="Yoma 81a:11">Yoma 81ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>בעצם</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 23:30">Lev. XXIII, 30</cite>) <he>על עיצומו של יום וכ׳</he> labor on the day itself is punished with extinction (contrad. to <cite ref="V00246"><he>תוספת</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: pl. עִיצּוּמִים, עִיצּוּמִין, עִצּ׳ (cmp. אַסְמַכְתָּא) surety, a promise made with the condition of a forfeit in case of failure to fulfill it.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 10:5:2">Y. B. Bath. X, 17ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ע׳ … גבי</he> R. A. decided a promise of forfeit to be collectible.

Y. Gitt. V, 47ᵇ, [read as:] Y. B. Bath. l. c. אע״ג דלית לר׳ יוסי גבי ע׳ … דאינון גביי וכ׳ although R. J. declares ʿitsumim not to be collectible, he admits that they are collectible in the case of those who indenture their sons to a trade, because the livelihood of men requires such a measure.
